Locomotive wheels clearly belong to load above deck. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Fill inter-arch gaps between tandem/bogie/trailer axles down to hub line with continuous shadowed chassis/suspension too. NO transparent holes above hub line even when separate tires drop by a third radius. Below hub line lower half of each tire circle stays truly transparent; ground clearance below chassis stays transparent. No rubber tread, rims, road-wheel discs, black full-circle silhouettes, tire ghosts, or far-side tires. Keep ALL OTHER original master pixels unchanged, exact same canvas dimensions and vehicle/load position, scale, camera and details. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration, weathered materials and fine mechanical detail, soft even light. True alpha transparent background, no checkerboard, halo, ground, shadows, added text or watermark. Whole object within original margins. Return only edited image at exact original dimensions.
